summary: OKYO Pharma Ltd furnished a Form 6-K (foreign-private-issuer current report equivalent) announcing participation in the Stifel 2026 Healthcare Conference on November 10–12, 2026, with CEO Robert J. Dempsey presenting at 9:20 a.m. ET on November 12 at the Lotte New York Palace Hotel. Leadership will hold one-on-one investor meetings arranged through Stifel representatives; a live webcast will be archived 90 days on the company's investor site. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. The exhibit is furnished and incorporated by reference into the Form F-3 shelf. Routine investor-relations event; no deal or risk-arb angle.
